headline: Prepare for the account conversation from one evidence view
capabilities: Get a single unified view of account signals across diverse sources
Create stakeholder maps with influence scores/relationship gaps
Deliver competitive insights and risk mitigation strategies
Produced talking points and pre-meeting checklists
outcomes: Improved win rates via better stakeholder coverage and competitive positioning
Reduced account research time from hours to minutes
Elevated deal quality with tailored messaging and risk mitigation
Enabled real-time team alignment with automated alerts and updates
why_try: A seller can ask what matters before a meeting and receive both the evidence and the gaps that need human follow-up.

sample_prompts.label: Review the account
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare a synthetic Acme Corporation account overview and show the evidence that deserves seller attention.

sample_prompts.label: Map the buying committee
sample_prompts.prompt: Map the synthetic Acme buying committee and show the relationship gaps without creating outreach tasks.

sample_prompts.label: Compare competitor signals
sample_prompts.prompt: Compare the synthetic competitor signals and positioning considerations for Acme Corporation.

sample_prompts.label: Draft meeting talking points
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft persona-specific talking points for the synthetic Acme meeting; do not send messages.

sample_prompts.label: Assess deal risks
sample_prompts.prompt: Assess the synthetic Acme deal risks and mitigation options without changing a forecast or CRM record.

sample_prompts.label: Prepare the executive briefing
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare a concise synthetic Acme pre-meeting briefing and review checklist.

business_flow: Account executive, sales director, or customer success manager
